notes.title: Pre-Odyssey: Demo 1.1 Update is Live! 🦆
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just updated the Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack demo to version 1.1! Here’s what’s new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550499/020f230154fa19a06c8289e799f8483f2771a5d3.jpg
 

 Polished and refined scenes
 Fixed the error some players encountered on startup
 Voice Audio Fixes
 Optimized how the game launches on Steam for a smoother experience


Huge thanks to everyone who has played the demo so far! Your support, kind words, and feedback mean the world to us 💖

The full release is coming fast; June 17 is just around the corner!
If you’ve enjoyed the demo, please consider telling a friend and adding the game to your wishlist. It really helps!

Follow us here on Steam for news, giveaways and events!

<3 Anta & Neoclassic Games
